from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name associated with this report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial metric found")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency or unit (e.g. Yuan)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the data")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text excerpt containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
